description: The finite Boolean truth-table equivalence test returns true exactly when the two formulas have the same value under every valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.checkEquivalent_eq_true.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.checkEquivalent A B = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A B
